Company_Code.description: Company Code. Valid Company in Spectrum.

Subcontract_Number.description: No duplicate combination of Vendor and Subcontract number.

Phase_Code.description: No dashes. Must exist on the Job and required if not defined on Subcontract.

Cost_Type.description: Must exist on the Job and required if not defined on Subcontract.

Bid_Item_Number.description: The billing item is broken into Group and Item for Unit Price jobs. The first 2 characters will be defined as the Group when the Job is Unit Price.

Retention_Flag.description: (Y)es or (N)o. Defaults to N if blank or based on Phase.

Original_Contract_Amount.description: If Unit_Price and Original_Contract_Quantity are populated then Original_Contract_Amount is calculated. Allows negatives. Format = -9.2
